1_muqattaat_jabari.claim: every muqattaat sura is Meccan except Zahrawan (2,3) and al-Rad (13)

2_munafiqun_makki.claim: every sura mentioning the munafiqun is Medinan except al-Ankabut (29)
2_munafiqun_makki.citation: al-Suyuti Itqan nawʿ 1, Makki b. Abi Talib (line 1175)
2_munafiqun_makki.disambiguation: raw root-nfq (incl. anfaqa 'spend') spans 31 surahs; hypocrite-sense lemmas only span 11

3a_amanu_medinan.claim: every sura with 'ya ayyuha alladhina amanu' is Medinan
3a_amanu_medinan.citation: al-Suyuti Itqan nawʿ 1, Ibn Masʿud via al-Hakim/al-Bayhaqi; Ibn ʿAtiyya 'sahih' (lines 1146-1151)

3b_nas_meccan.claim: every sura with 'ya ayyuha al-nas' is Meccan (Ibn ʿAtiyya: but al-nas MAY come in Medinan)
3b_nas_meccan.citation: al-Suyuti Itqan nawʿ 1, Ibn Masʿud; Ibn ʿAtiyya qualification (line 1152, 1158)
3b_nas_meccan.note: Ibn ʿAtiyya in the SAME passage flags al-nas as fallible; al-Nisaʾ (Q4) opens with al-nas yet is Medinan

4_sajda_hudhali.claim: every sura containing a sajda (prostration verse) is Meccan
4_sajda_hudhali.citation: al-Suyuti Itqan nawʿ 1, al-Hudhali al-Kamil (line 1176); sajda list nawʿ 19 (lines 6783-6786)
4_sajda_hudhali.disambiguation: Q13 al-Raʿd + Q22 al-Hajj are mukhtalaf-fiha; al-Suyuti himself (Itqan nawʿ 1, lines 788-789/843-844/852-853) records authoritative Meccan readings (Ibn ʿAbbas, ʿAli b. Abi Talha, Saʿid b. Jubayr). al-Jaʿbari's twin criterion (Claim 1) lists al-Raʿd as an explicit muqattaat exception. Under the Meccan reading the rule holds.
4_sajda_hudhali.note: FALSIFIED under binary Tanzil label; RULES-FRAGILE because the only two counterexamples are precisely the surahs al-Suyuti flags as disputed-with-Meccan-reading

5_kalla_upper_half.claim: rebuke-kalla (33x) never at Yathrib and never in the upper half of the Quran
5_kalla_upper_half.citation: al-Suyuti Itqan nawʿ 1, al-Dirini verse / al-Dani (lines 1178-1180); midpoint nawʿ 19 line 4362
5_kalla_upper_half.disambiguation: raw substring كلا spans 29 surahs incl. quantifier kullan/kila (e.g. Q4,6,7,11,17); QAC POS=AVR lemma kal~aA = 33, all in surahs 19-104
